Presenting KISI PE DIL AGAR AA JAYE TOH KYA HOTA HAI FULL VIDEO SONG from RAFOO CHAKKAR movie starring Rishi Kapoor, Neetu Singh, Madan Puri & Rajendranath in lead roles, released in 1975. The song is sung by Shailendra Singh, Asha Bhosle and music is given by Kalyanji Anandji, music is available exclusively on Gaane Sune Ansune.
Watch superhit songs of reel & real life couple Neetu Singh and Rishi Kapoor
